opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three (maximum contribution)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post, hold a doctorate, have submitted their thesis for viva by the closing date, and are based in the UK (either holding a UK degree or a UK academic position).
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, covering salary costs (100 % year 1, 50 % years 2‑3) and up to £6,000 per year for research expenses.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal investigators employed by UK universities or other UK higher‑education institutions (and on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes) who will direct the grant; co‑applicants may be from the same or different institutions, including overseas collaborators.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for innovative research projects up to five years, covering staff costs (minimum 75 % of budget for research staff), equipment, travel, consumables and other research expenses.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university academic staff (with research degree awarding powers) who will act as host coordinator; the visiting professor is invited from overseas. Host institution must administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Funds visits by eminent overseas professors to UK institutions to bring novel expertise, with awards ranging £10‑150k for visits of 3‑12 months (up to 2 years total).

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post at a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK, and members of the UK scholarly community.
opportunities.summary: Supports experienced researchers whose teaching/administrative duties have limited their research time, providing up to £70,000 for up to 24 months, with funding for replacement costs and research expenses.
